description: React component for displaying and managing team members, including functions for formatting numbers, retrieving user spend, budget, and rate limits, and rendering a table with team member details and actions.

methods.name: formatNumber
methods.description: Converts a number or null to a string, handling scientific notation and formatting with commas.

methods.name: getUserSpend
methods.description: Retrieves the spend amount for a user based on user ID.

methods.name: getUserBudget
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the maximum budget for a user.

methods.name: getUserRateLimits
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the rate limits (RPM and TPM) for a user.
